//: The CHECKING config — what `pnpm typecheck` and the editor use. It sees src,
test and scripts, and emits nothing.
It used to be `include: ["src/**/*.ts"]` on the config that ALSO emitted, so
`pnpm typecheck` reported success without ever reading a test file. Sprint 10
STEP 2 added a required field to HandleMessageArgs and broke 33 call sites under
test/ while the gate stayed green; they surfaced only under vitest, at runtime.
A gate that passes while broken is worse than no gate.
The emitting config is tsconfig.build.json, deliberately separate. Widening the
include HERE while this config still emitted would break the deploy rather than
CI: TypeScript infers the common source root from the file set, so dist/server.js
would silently become dist/src/server.js and package.json's `node dist/server.js`
(Railway's start command) would fail on deploy.
